title: A description changed through the public API shows Changed through: Public API
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin who can pick two locations in the location selector, {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) and {Location-B} (for example Staging Lethbridge - 4310). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-APIHIST-01) is active at both {Location-A} and {Location-B}, on one Part Library entry.
  • Its description was {Description-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL APIHIST PART").
  • A connected system has changed the description to {Description-B} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST PL APIHIST PART NEW") through ShopView's public API. This cannot be done in the ShopView screens.
custom_steps:
1. Pick {Location-A} in the location selector in the top bar.
  2. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  3. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  4. Click the clock icon (tooltip "Part History") at the left of the {Part-A} row.
  5. Pick {Location-B} in the location selector.
  6. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  7. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
  8. Click the clock icon at the left of the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: At {Location-A} the part shows the description {Description-B}.
  • Step 4: Part History at {Location-A} has the entry "Description updated | Original description: {Description-A} | New description: {Description-B} | Changed through: Public API", with no "Changed at".
  • Step 7: At {Location-B} the part shows {Description-B} too.
  • Step 8: Part History at {Location-B} has the same entry, also ending "| Changed through: Public API" and not "| Changed at".
  • Steps 1 to 8: This case needs a change made through the public API. If no connected system made it, write "public API change not available, not checked by hand" in the result comment and mark the case Blocked.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change); story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S10-R25a, S10-R24, S13-R19d, S13-R14, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas: no board shows this behaviour (13 Oct copy). Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026), §5 API Changes (public API PATCH). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R25a: “Entries written for a change made through the public API end with "| Changed through: Public API" at every location, in place of "| Changed at: {location}".”
  • S10-R24: “A changed description writes "Description updated | Original description: {old} | New description: {new}" to the Part History of the part at every location that stocks it.”
  • S13-R19d: “A change to a part's number or description made through the public API follows the same rules as the part dialog: S13-R14, S13-R15, S13-R18, S13-R19, S13-N1, S13-N7 and S10-R23 to S10-R25.”
  • S13-R14: “Saving a changed description changes the part's Part Library entry, so every location that stocks the part shows the new description.”
